Color palettes for hexamaps

Source: R/scales.R
hexamap_palette.Rd

Returns n colors from a named palette. The default, "jet", is the palette used in Jalal and Burke (2020). Any palette from grDevices::hcl.pals() can also be used, such as "viridis" (perceptually uniform and readable by people with color vision deficiencies), "Inferno", "YlOrRd", or the diverging "Blue-Red 3".

Usage

hexamap_palette(name = "jet", n = 100)

Arguments

name

Name of the palette: "jet" or a name from grDevices::hcl.pals(). Matching ignores case and spaces.

n

Number of colors.

Value

A character vector of n colors, from low to high.

Examples

hexamap_palette("jet", 5)
#> [1] "#000000" "#001FFF" "#3FFFBF" "#FF9E00" "#7F0000"
hexamap_palette("viridis", 5)
#> [1] "#4B0055" "#00588B" "#009B95" "#53CC67" "#FDE333"
hexamap_palette("Blue-Red 3", 5)
#> [1] "#002F70" "#879FDB" "#F6F6F6" "#DA8A8B" "#5F1415"
